start_here: Say to your AI: "Delete the Hetzner DNS zone example.com (rollback)." It runs tool:delete-a-hetzner-dns-zone with the zone name.
no_lists_because: It keeps no list of yours: it reads or changes your Hetzner DNS zones.
instructions: 1. Say to your AI what to do, with the zone name and the record values.
2. The AI calls tools:run with the tool and its input.
3. Read the answer; a change is real, so check it with tool:read-hetzner-dns-rrsets.

worked_examples.title: Delete a Hetzner DNS zone
worked_examples.ask: Delete the Hetzner DNS zone example.com (rollback).
worked_examples.given: Reads tools/hetzner-dns/tool-rows.json: DELETE https://api.hetzner.cloud/v1/zones/{zone} with the vault key hetzner-api-token as a bearer header, to api.hetzner.cloud only.
worked_examples.hands_back: It answers that zone example.com is deleted, with its id 42.
